notes.title: Achievements! Kitty hats!
notes.content:
Jones On Fire now has kitty hats, in honor of Hot Tin Roof (its noir successor). They're purchasable in the shop, each hat has 2 levels, and they're all adorable.

Jones On Fire ALSO now has achievements! They're tied to ranks of unlocked ability, and you can get them even if you've already maxed everything out. Just open up the ability page in the store where you'd normally upgrade it (and the button says "MAX RANK" or whatever instead of "BUY"), and it'll give you the achievement.

notes.title: We just added trading cards!
notes.content:
This was easily our #1 requested thing, so - hey! Trading Cards! They should be earning for you as of this typing. The rarest emote is the golden kitty itself, and there's some nifty backgrounds and other stuff. The usual.

Enjoy!
